full_name: Rebecca Newberger Goldstein | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Rebecca Newberger Goldstein is a philosopher and the author of five novels, including Properties of Light (Houghton Mifflin, 2000); a collection of short stories, Strange Attractors (Viking, 1993); and two books of nonfiction, most recently Betraying Spinoza: The Renegade Jew Who Gave Us Modernity (Schocken, 2006). Her work, both fiction and nonfiction, attempts to convey the aesthetic and emotional aspects of abstract intellectual pursuits, whether philosophy, mathematical logic, or quantum mechanics.
